dex.text: Smells of struck matches and lives in a nest of warm ash. Politely asks you not to call it the small volcano.
dex.fact: The Soufriere Hills volcano on Montserrat began erupting in 1995 after centuries of quiet, and has had several phases of activity since.

dex.text: Grumbles in the hills for decades and then ruins everyone's afternoon. Buried a capital once and still gets a bit sulky if you mention it.
dex.fact: Eruptions of the Soufriere Hills volcano buried Plymouth, Montserrat's capital, under ash and mud from 1995 and 1997; the southern part of the island is now an exclusion zone.
